# School AI Portal

> Deterministic, privacy-first, on-device AI educational portal running via in-browser WebRTC loopback channels and localized model runtimes.

## Overview
- Architecture: Zero-backend, zero-cost edge deployment via GitHub Pages and Docusaurus.
- Inference: In-browser WebRTC data channels (DTLS/SCTP) communicating with local inference endpoints (Ollama / Chrome Prompt API / WebLLM).
- Data Privacy: Zero telemetry, zero cloud logging; user state persists exclusively in local IndexedDB.
